decisions.rationale: Candidate grants auditors deletion permission, violating the administrator-or-owner requirement; the auditor test fails.
For restricted ASCII inputs, strip plus casefold implements whitespace trimming and lowercase normalization; the committed test passes.
Non-empty behavior satisfies the specification and its test passes, but intended empty-sequence behavior is explicitly unspecified and changed from the base.
Candidate returns zero instead of raising ConfigError for malformed or out-of-range input; the malformed-input test fails.
Candidate negates the arithmetic sum, directly violating the specification; the committed total test fails.

strategy_update: Prioritize specification semantics and exact diff/test evidence; abstain only when a claim depends on behavior the public specification leaves unspecified.
